episodeTitle.en: Matt Mullenweg on the future of open source and why he’s taking a stand
episodeTitle.zh: 马特·马伦威格谈论开源的未来及他的立场

guestBioOfficial.en: Matt Mullenweg is the co-founder of WordPress, the open source platform powering a staggering 43% of the internet. He also serves as CEO of Automattic—the parent company of brands like WordPress.com, WooCommerce, and Tumblr—which is worth over $7 billion, with over 1,700 employees across 90 countries. In this episode, he discusses some of the most controversial topics surrounding WordPress, Automattic, and the broader open source community. What you’ll learn:
guestBioOfficial.zh: 马特·马伦威格是WordPress的联合创始人，WordPress是为互联网提供支持的开源平台，占据了惊人的43%的市场份额。他还担任Automattic的首席执行官——Automattic是WordPress.com、WooCommerce和Tumblr等品牌的母公司，市值超过70亿美元，员工超过1700人，分布在90个国家。在本期节目中，他讨论了围绕WordPress、Automattic和更广泛的开源社区的一些最具争议的话题。你将学到：

title.en: Matt Mullenweg on the future of open source and why he’s taking a stand
title.zh: 马特·马伦威格谈论开源的未来及他的立场

summary.en: Matt defends open-source ideals in his public battle with WP Engine, arguing the company diluted the WordPress brand through a "bastardized" managed version. He reflects on how 20+ years of goodwill were tested and why protecting the commons matters. The episode offers a candid look at the politics and principles of the open-source world.
summary.zh: 马特在他与 WP Engine 的公开较量中捍卫开源理念，认为后者通过"被篡改"的托管版本稀释了 WordPress 品牌。他反思了二十多年的口碑如何受到考验，以及保护"公共品"为何重要。本期坦诚呈现了开源世界的政治与原则。
